label: Abandoned cart reports
description: Abandoned and recovered carts for a single reporting period.

fields.label: Period
fields.description: Human-readable label for the reporting period.

fields.label: Period start
fields.description: When the period starts (shown in your local time).

fields.label: Period end
fields.description: When the period ends (shown in your local time).

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Currency the amounts are reported in.

fields.label: Abandoned value
fields.description: Total value of the carts abandoned in this period.

fields.label: Recovered
fields.description: Abandoned carts that later became an order.

fields.label: Recovery rate %
fields.description: Recovered carts as a share of abandoned carts.

fields.label: vs previous
fields.description: Percentage change in abandoned carts compared with the previous period.

fields.label: Abandoned cart report summary
fields.description: Headline figures for this period. Hover the info icon on a figure for what it counts.

rows.label: Abandoned carts
rows.hint: Carts abandoned in this period, including any that later became an order. Swell counts a cart as abandoned after about 3 hours without activity.

rows.label: Abandoned change
rows.hint: Percentage change in abandoned carts compared with the previous period.

rows.label: Still open
rows.hint: Abandoned carts in this period that have not become an order.

rows.label: Abandoned value
rows.hint: Total value of those carts when they were abandoned.

rows.label: Average abandoned cart
rows.hint: Abandoned value divided by the number of abandoned carts.

rows.label: Recovered carts
rows.hint: Abandoned carts in this period that later became an order, up to when the report ran.

rows.label: Recovery rate
rows.hint: Recovered carts as a share of abandoned carts.

rows.label: Recovered revenue
rows.hint: Revenue from those orders that have been paid.

fields.label: Largest abandoned carts
fields.description: The highest-value carts abandoned in this period, up to 10. Click a name to open the customer.

params.empty: No carts were abandoned in this period.
params.unlisted_note: {n} more abandoned carts were not listed. Each report lists up to 10.

fields.label: Products left in carts
fields.description: The products with the most value left in this period's abandoned carts, up to 10.

params.empty: No carts were abandoned in this period.

fields.label: Partial
fields.description: Set when a read hit its page ceiling, so counts are a lower bound.

fields.label: vs previous
fields.template: {% if abandoned_change_pct > 0 %}▲ {{ abandoned_change_pct }}%{% elsif abandoned_change_pct < 0 %}▼ {{ abandoned_change_pct | abs }}%{% else %}—{% endif %}
